sources.title: Astra N807 adverse comparison
sources.use: Conditional fresh-draw premises, nested cost and finite-precision limitations retained.

sources.title: Godreche and Luck, Single-spin-flip dynamics of the Ising chain
sources.use: Actual nonlinear kinetic-Ising family and its limited exact closures.

sources.title: Sturm and Swart, Tightness of voter model interfaces
sources.use: Established odd-interface recurrence and inversion-count method; not an automatic bounded-variance computation.

sources.title: Balazs and Nagy, Dependent Double Branching Annihilating Random Walk
sources.use: Governing positive dual, alternating charges and voter/exclusion correspondence.

sources.title: MacPhee et al., Passage-time moments and hybrid zones
sources.use: Pure-voter 3/2 moment obstruction; asymmetric-mixture higher-moment hypothesis not silently transferred.

sources.title: Bruna et al., Proving the Herman-Protocol Conjecture
sources.use: Existing cubic/quintic polynomials, collision interfaces, synchronous-token drift and maxima. Target branching drift proved separately.

sources.title: Awad, Glynn, Rubinstein, Zero-Variance Importance Sampling Estimators
sources.use: Markov reward, regenerative ratio and importance-sampling prior. No claim to invent Doob transforms.

sources.title: Maurer and Pontil, Empirical Bernstein Bounds
sources.use: Theorem4 one-sided concentration; four separately bounded endpoint variables with union allocation.

sources.title: Golub, Matrix Computation and the Theory of Moments
sources.use: Conventional Gauss-Radau bounds using the acquired reference scalar.

sources.title: Oppelstrup et al., First-Passage Kinetic Monte Carlo
sources.use: Serious physical diffusion-skipping competitor; not acquired for this complete Ising response, so ordinary-event cost is not a universal lower bound.

sources.title: Shapira, A Thomson-type variational principle for diffusion coefficients
sources.use: Constructive lower-flow comparison for infinite conserved nongradient gas; executed in conventional/.

sources.title: Funaki, Gu and Wang, Quantitative homogenization
sources.use: Convergent finite-volume upper/dual bounds and explicit finite-state fallback; numerical constants not assumed.

sources.title: Arita, Krapivsky and Mallick, Bulk diffusion in a kinetically constrained lattice gas
sources.use: Finite-local-function upper construction, paired with acquired lower flows.
